funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals from low-income households ordinarily resident in Scotland who are ineligible for government tuition fee support, studying an undergraduate degree at an eligible Scottish higher education institution. Must be entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK (or have limited leave to remain / be an asylum seeker).
opportunities.summary: Grants covering tuition fees for undergraduate students at Scottish higher education institutions who are not eligible for government funding for their tuition fees. Includes a second-degree scheme for those reskilling in skills shortage areas.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants

amount.raw: Contribution towards Home-rate tuition fees up to £10,000 (full-time) or £5,000 per year (part-time); plus study-cost stipend up to £5,000 (full-time) or £2,500 per year (part-time)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to graduates from low-income Scottish households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, have a meaningful connection to Scotland, and have secured a place on an eligible taught or research master's programme at a Scottish higher education institution. Must not already hold a master's-level qualification.
opportunities.summary: Grants to help graduates from low-income Scottish households meet the costs of postgraduate master's study at Scottish universities, supporting tuition fees and, in some cases, study costs.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Vacation Scholarships

amount.raw: Stipend to cover living expenses calculated using the Scottish Living Wage rate for projects of 4-12 weeks duration

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to undergraduate students from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland and enrolled on an undergraduate degree at an eligible Scottish institution, in the penultimate year of their degree.
opportunities.summary: Scholarships enabling undergraduate students to develop research skills by designing and executing an independent summer research project under academic supervision.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie-Morgan Scholarship

amount.raw: Full tuition fees for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants plus a living-cost bursary of £1,200

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to students accepted onto the MSc Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants (delivered by Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh and University of Edinburgh) from low-income Scottish households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland and have a connection to Scotland.
opportunities.summary: Scholarship providing full tuition fees and a living-cost bursary for Scottish-domiciled students from low-income households to undertake postgraduate study in plant science and botany (MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants), in partnership with the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh.
